blocks.title: Pehli electron affinity
blocks.text: Pehli electron affinity, delta Hea, woh enthalpy tabdeeli hai jab standard halaat ke tehat gaseous atoms ke ek mole mein electrons ka ek mole shamil ho kar gaseous yak-manfi (uni-negative) ions ka ek mole bane.
Chlorine ke liye, Cl(g) + e- se Cl-(g), delta H = -348.8 kJ fi mol; energy kharij hoti hai, to pehli electron affinity manfi nishan rakhti hai. Electron affinity ki tafseeli bahas chapter 1 mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Sulfur ki pehli electron affinity -200 kJ fi mol aur doosri +640 kJ fi mol hai. S(g) + 2e- se S2-(g) ke liye delta H nikalein, aur doosri affinity ka nishan samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Dono qadam jama kar ke: -200 + 640 = +440 kJ fi mol. Doosra electron pehle se manfi ion par us ki dhakel ke khilaf dhakelna hota hai, to energy jazb hoti hai aur doosri affinity musbat hai.

items: Pehli electron affinity: gaseous atoms ka ek mole electrons ka ek mole le kar gaseous yak-manfi ions deta hai; manfi kyunke energy kharij hoti hai (Cl -348.8 kJ fi mol); doosri affinity musbat hai.
